audit.report: A replayable batch job (batch_replayable_inventory, pid 102347) sat idle in transaction for 4 seconds while holding locks that blocked 12 checkout sessions, dropping checkout success to 82% against a 95% SLO and putting $3,286/min of revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocker; the Continuity Guardian accepted after a trade-off showed waiting for the job's ~896s remaining runtime would cost ~$49,067 in lost checkout revenue versus a 4-minute replay cost. Authority authorized the termination, the executor killed the session, and the verifier confirmed full recovery: zero lock waits and 100% checkout success (36/36) over 10 seconds. Total negotiation and execution took 76.6 seconds in a single round.
audit.root_cause: An idle-in-transaction batch_replayable_inventory worker (pid 102347) held locks that blocked checkout sessions, degrading checkout success to 82% and risking $3,286/min in revenue.
lessons: Add a statement_timeout or idle_in_transaction_session_timeout for batch_replayable_inventory workers so they self-terminate before blocking checkout for more than a few seconds.
Instrument batch_replayable_inventory to emit a heartbeat or checkpoint metric; alert if a worker stays in 'idle in transaction' > 5s so on-call can intervene before checkout impact.
Document the 4-minute replay SLA for inventory_reconcile in the runbook so future guardians can cite the exact recovery cost without probing the workload registry.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian cited precise evidence (lock waiter count, idle duration, memory of prior successful termination) and the Continuity Guardian accepted immediately after the business calculator quantified the $49k wait cost versus 4-minute replay; no rounds were wasted and no invariants were violated.
follow_ups: Configure idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 10s for the batch_worker role to auto-terminate stuck replays.
Add a Prometheus alert on pg_stat_activity where state = 'idle in transaction' and application_name = 'batch_replayable_inventory' and xact_start < now() - interval '5 seconds'.
Update the inventory_reconcile runbook with the verified 4-minute replay time and 'may_interrupt' policy reference.
